title: China Price Check: Bullet Train $84 for 1,318 km — 6¢ a km | China Travel Expert
description:
How is a 1,318 km bullet-train ride in China only about $84?

A second-class seat from Beijing to Shanghai (1,318 km) runs roughly ¥576–650 — about $84, or ~6¢ per kilometer, and the fare is fixed (no dynamic pricing). By comparison, a standard-fare high-speed ticket in Europe — e.g. TGV Paris–Marseille (661 km) at ~€110 booked a week out — works out to roughly 18¢/km, about triple. Same tier, both converted to USD, verified this run.

🧭 Expert Tip: book on the official 12306 app a few days ahead and pick a second-class (二等) seat — same train, a fraction of the flight price.
